title: Chapter 2 scan state must allow firing
repro_steps: Enter scan state and hold movement plus fire.
expected: Scan, movement, and auto-fire run concurrently; target is immune.
root_cause: Player.update auto-fire guard only matched PLAYING.
verification: Hold fire for five seconds during scan; scan completes and target survives.

title: Armor penetration needs visible payoff
repro_steps: Equip penetration module and hit an elite or boss.
expected: Distinct platinum projectile, continuation, and ARMOR PIERCED cue.
actual: Penetration changed numbers without distinct presentation.
root_cause: No dedicated penetration render or hit-feedback contract.
verification: Compare normal and penetration shots for trail, multi-hit, and cue.
regression_test: Projectile, boss weak point, cleanup, and performance smoke tests.

title: Add bounded in-run Rogue healing
repro_steps: Take damage, equip medkit, kill an elite, and collect healing crystal.
expected: Healing clamps at max HP, updates both HUD bars, and shows feedback.
actual: No in-run healing drop or unified recovery entry point.
root_cause: Healing lacked a concrete trigger, cap, and HUD contract.
verification: Trigger recovery three times while damaged and confirm clamp and feedback.
regression_test: Damage/death, restart, convoy, and boss integrity smoke tests.

title: Third scan beacon can disappear from wave timing
repro_steps: Play chapter 2, collect the first two scan beacons slowly, and wait through wave three.
expected: A third beacon appears whenever scanning is incomplete and no beacon is active.
actual: The third beacon could fail to spawn after its scheduled wave had already passed.
root_cause: Beacon creation was tied only to wave index rather than scan progression.
verification: Delay the first two scans, then confirm beacon 3 appears and choice unlocks after collection.
regression_test: Chapter 2 scan progression and branch-choice smoke test.

title: Right HUD repeats pilot portrait and ship identity
repro_steps: Start a run and inspect the top-right communications panel and dialogue bar.
expected: One compact AI communications portrait is shown; pilot name is shown once and ship name is not repeated in the HUD.
actual: Pilot portrait, pilot name, and ship name were repeated across the same HUD/dialogue area.
root_cause: The communications panel rendered both a speaker portrait and a second pilot portrait, while labels concatenated pilot and ship identity.
verification: Inspect all three pilots and trigger dialogue; confirm compact panel and single identity label.
regression_test: HUD layout smoke test at desktop and narrow viewport sizes.

title: Dialogue labels expose internal English identifiers
repro_steps: Trigger chapter one and chapter two dialogue.
expected: Dialogue headers use localized Chinese role names without internal English identifiers.
actual: PLAYER, SYSTEM, and REBEL_COMMANDER could appear before Chinese dialogue text.
root_cause: The renderer wrote internal speaker keys directly into the dialogue header.
verification: Trigger pilot, system, and rebel commander lines; confirm Chinese headers only.
regression_test: Dialogue parser and chapter dialogue smoke tests.

title: Chapter 2 minions ignore route faction
repro_steps: Play chapter 2 before choice and then select either route.
expected: Pre-choice minions are rebel skiffs; protection uses imperial drones; execute uses rebel interceptors.
actual: Pre-choice waves could spawn imperial aircraft regardless of route.
root_cause: Enemy faction was selected randomly before branch state existed.
verification: Observe pre-choice and post-choice waves on both routes.
regression_test: Chapter 2 wave, branch boss, and convoy smoke tests.

title: Scan areas lack readable visual anchors
repro_steps: Enter chapter one rescue scan or chapter two beacon scan.
expected: Scan corridor, beacon, and rescue pod remain readable against the background.
actual: Dark backgrounds and low-contrast placeholders made scans hard to see.
root_cause: Scan states lacked a contrast layer and placeholder signal asset.
verification: Inspect both scan states with active enemies and confirm markers remain visible.
regression_test: Chapter opening, chapter two scan progression, and asset checks.
